limitations: This exact helper is a disposable-lab oracle and is not installed on production customer machines.
The probe proves the Windows guest and desktop in which the observer runs; a nested remote desktop inside that guest needs its own observer or a separate visual identity contract.
The visual oracle is exact but 13.625 seconds is too slow for every production action; it is a benchmark checkpoint, not the hot control loop.
